sections.title: S1: WARM UP - Jerks
sections.description:
Weightlifting, Warm up 

a. General prep  
4 min Ski (Easy-Moderate tempo)
-Into-
1-2 rounds of:
Banded ATWYEI routine (10 of each)
1 minute Anterior stretch 
30 sec Back Bridge hold

b. Specific prep
10 Alt. Front and Back Strict press (empty barbell)
-Rest as needed-
10 Alt. Front and Back Push press (empty barbell)
-Rest as needed-
10 Alt. Front and Back Push Jerk (empty barbell)
-Rest as needed-
10 Alt. Front and Back Split Jerk (empty barbell)

attachments.title: Strict Press from the back + Strict press from the front
Push Press from the back + Push press from the front
Push Jerks from the back + Push Jerks from the front
Split Jerks from the back + Split Jerks from the front

sections.title: S1: STRENGTH-SPEED (Jerks)
sections.description:
Strength-Speed / "Power" / Weightlifting, Jerks

a. 3 sets, Going every 2:00 minute
3 Split Jerks (70-80% of 1RM = @70%1RM_SPLIT_JERK-@80%1RM_SPLIT_JERK)

b. 3 sets, Going every 2:00 minute
2 Split Jerks (75-85% of 1RM = @75%1RM_SPLIT_JERK-@85%1RM_SPLIT_JERK)

c. 3 sets, Going every 2:00 minute
1 Split Jerk (80-90% of 1RM = @80%1RM_SPLIT_JERK-@90%1RM_SPLIT_JERK)

d. (Optional Speed/Power-Endurance)
10 minute EMOM
1: 10 Single arm DB STOH (right arm)
2: 10 Single arm DB STOH (left arm)

Load:
[Elite] 1x32.5/22.5kg │ 1x70/50lbs
[RX] 1x25/17.5kg │ 1x60/40lbs
[Intermediate] 1x22.5/15kg │ 1x50/35lbs

Progression:
W1: 3 sets of 3 reps, 3 sets of 2 reps, 3 sets of 1 rep + Optional barbell cycling work 
W2: Same volume and format, aim to progress loads. (+2.5% from last week)
W3: Same volume and format, aim to progress loads.(+2.5% from last week) (Current) 
W4: Transition week
----------------------------------
Read more about how weightlifting is developed in our program in attached document.

sections.title: S1: ABSOLUTE STRENGTH (Hinge)
sections.description:
Strength, Posterior Lower-body (Hinge)

a. 6 sets, Going every 3rd minute
Set 1, 4: 5 Deadlifts
Set 2, 5: 3 Deadlifts
Set 3, 6: 1 Deadlift

*(Optional) Absolute Speed add-on: After each set perform:
Option #1: 3 Seated Broad jumps onto a box.
Option #2: 6 Banded KB swings (24-32/16-24kg + Blue band)
Option #3: 3 Sandbag KB or Slamball overhead tosses for distance (10-24/8-16kg │ 25-54/15-35lbs)

Load: Wave load format. Suggested loads below:
Set 1: 5 reps at 70% of 1RM (@70%1RM_DEADLIFT)
Set 2: 3 reps at 80% of 1RM (@80%1RM_DEADLIFT)
Set 3: 1 rep at 90% of 1RM (@90%1RM_DEADLIFT)
Set 4: 5 reps at 75% of 1RM (@75%1RM_DEADLIFT)
Set 5: 3 reps at 85% of 1RM (@85%1RM_DEADLIFT)
Set 6: 1 rep at 95% of 1RM (@95%1RM_DEADLIFT)

Tempo: As aggressive and strong upwards as possible, Controlled descent, No Pause in the bottom.

Deadlift tips: https://www.instagram.com/p/DZ-0wgoRYz2/?hl=en

Progression:
W1: 7-5-3-7-5-3 Deadlifts 
W2: 6-4-2-6-4-2 Deadlifts (Heavier than last week) 
W3: 5-3-1-5-3-1 Deadlifts (Heavier than last week) (current)
W4: Transition week.
----------------------------------
Read more about how strength is developed in our program in attached document.

sections.title: S1: STRENGTH ENDURANCE (Lunge/Pull)
sections.description:
Strength Endurance, Unilateral lower body + Posterior Upper-body (Lunge & Pull)

a. 3-4 sets,
8-12 Double DB Bent over rows
-Rest 60 sec-
8/8 Bulgarian split squats
-Rest 60 sec-

Load: (You can use the same weight for both. Below are suggestions)
[Elite] 2x32.5/22.5kg | 2x70/50lbs
[RX]  2x22.5/15kg | 2x50/35lbs
[Intermediate] 2x17.5/12.5kg | 2x40/30lbs

Intent: Improve muscle endurance qualities in unilateral lower-body and pulling exercises.
----------------------------------

sections.title: S1: (OPTIONAL) STRENGTH ACCESSORY (Strongman)
sections.description:
(Optional) Strength Accessory, Strongman

a. 3 sets, Rets 2 minutes between
100ft (30m) Chaos Suitcase carry (right)
100ft (30m) Chaos Suitcase carry (left)
100ft (30m) Single arm DB OH carry (right)
100ft (30m) Single arm DB OH carry (left)

Load: Pick a challenging weight for each. Below are suggestions for each level:
[Elite]
-KB's: 32/24kg hanging from a green band
-DB's: 32.5/22.5kg | 70/50lbs

[RX]
-KB's: 28/20kg hanging from a green band
-DB's: 27.5/20kg | 60/45lbs

[Intermediate]
-KB's: 24/16kg hanging from a green band
-DB's: 22.5/15kg | 50/35lbs

attachments.title: Single arm "Chaos" Suit case carry (green band double wrapped and used as handle)

sections.title: S2: CONDITIONING
sections.description:
Conditioning, “Raising the ceiling” (Threshold │ 80-85% effort │ Heavy-Severe intensity domain │ Z3-4)

a. Warm up
2 minute Ski (Easy)
2 minute Echo bike (Easy)
2 minute Row (Easy)
+
1 minute Ski (Moderate)
1 minute Echo bike (Moderate)
1 minute Row (Moderate)
+
30 sec Ski (Hard)
30 sec Echo bike (Hard)
30 sec Row (Hard)

b. Threshold intervals
-On 0:00-
5 sets, 
3 minute AMRAP / 2 minute rest
21/16 Cal Ski
15/12 Cal Echo
Max Cal Row in the remaining time
Intensity: "Raising the ceiling" (80-85% effort / “Threshold” / Highest repeatable effort / Heavy-Severe Intensity domain / Z4.)

-Rest 5 minutes-

5 sets, 
3 minute AMRAP / 2 minute rest
21/16 Cal Row
15/12 Cal Echo
Max Cal Ski in the remaining time
Intensity: "Raising the ceiling" (80-85% effort / “Threshold” / Highest repeatable effort / Heavy-Severe Intensity domain / Z4.)
---------------------------------
